name: media-figure.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  media-figure.scss — MANIFEST for the Media Figure Shadow DOM styles
//  (?inline, adopted into the <media-figure> shadow root). Split by
//  surface into media-figure/ partials (imported below):
//    _host         :host contracts + host-context fallbacks + zoom-to-fill
//    _figure       figure wrapper + loading shimmer + reduced-motion
//    _placeholder  render-placeholder SVG aspect-ratio slot
//    _media        render-media layers, video element, expand trigger
//  Shadow DOM isolation means internals.scss can't pierce this root —
//  all figure/placeholder/media rules must live here. Sizing context
//  crosses the boundary via --mf-w/--mf-h/--mf-max-w custom properties.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

@import 'media-figure/host';
@import 'media-figure/figure';
@import 'media-figure/placeholder';
@import 'media-figure/media';
